## Deliberate divergences

These answer 501 on purpose (`packages/api-management/src/divergences.ts`).

| Operation | Route | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GetInstallSettings` | `GET /install/settings` | There is no browser install wizard: `crombolo init` and schema-as-code stand a site up. |
| `PostInstallSetup` | `POST /install/setup` | There is no browser install wizard: `crombolo init` and schema-as-code stand a site up. |
| `PostInstallValidateDatabase` | `POST /install/validate-database` | There is no browser install wizard: `crombolo init` and schema-as-code stand a site up. |
| `PostUpgradeAuthorize` | `POST /upgrade/authorize` | Upgrades run from the command line with `crombolo upgrade`, not from the backoffice. |
| `GetUpgradeSettings` | `GET /upgrade/settings` | Upgrades run from the command line with `crombolo upgrade`, not from the backoffice. |

Nothing: every other operation is implemented.

## Delivery API

**8 / 8 operations served** — Umbraco's Delivery API v2 contract (`packages/contracts/DeliveryApi.json`), off unless a site enables it. Member sign-in under `v1/security/member/` is outside the contract, as in Umbraco.

| `GetContentItemByPath2.0` | `GET /content/item/{path}` | yes |
| `GetContentItems2.0` | `GET /content/items` | yes |
| `GetMedia2.0` | `GET /media` | yes |
